metadata.title: Seedance 3.0: Release Date Status & What We Know

sections.title: When will Seedance 3.0 be released?
paragraphs: As of October 12, 2026, we have not verified a formal Seedance 3.0 announcement or a usable 3.0 model ID in the official sources reviewed. This is a verification status, not proof that every third-party claim is false.

sections.title: Seedance release timeline so far
paragraphs: Past releases give the only factual basis for guessing. The gaps between major versions have been about eight months from 1.0 to 2.0 and under six months from 2.0 to 2.5. That is a pattern, not a schedule.

callout.title: How to check a claim
callout.text: Look for an announcement from ByteDance, Volcano Engine or Dreamina, and for the model appearing in an API provider's model list. Until both exist, treat the claim as unverified.

sections.title: What to use while you wait
paragraphs: Seedance 2.5 is the current model: clips up to 30 seconds, up to 50 reference files and sound generated with the picture. If cost matters more than length, Seedance 2.0 and its Fast and Mini tiers are cheaper. [Seedance 2.5 vs 2.0](/seedance-2-5-vs-2-0) compares them, and [What is Seedance?](/what-is-seedance) covers the model family.
